meta_description:
116K likes, 0 comments - farahdhukai on May 18, 2021: "I deleted my last post because my post partum anxiety just can’t handle it. People putting words in my mouth, attacking me for saying too much.. or not enough, attacking one another, fostering hate.... where did humanity go? What have we become? How have we become so divided?
.
At this point I need to look after my family and myself, so thank you to everyone who has been so kind and supportive all these years. From the bottom of my heart, you have meant the world to me.. but as of right now.. i have to say goodbye to social media ✌🏽💔".
